info.name: Devices API
info.description:
End-to-end flow for every Devices API endpoint.

1. Start the stack (`make up`) and import `local.postman_environment.json`.
2. Select the **Devices API · local** environment.
3. Run the whole collection with the Runner; folders run in order and share variables.

Tokens are minted automatically by the collection pre-request script from the environment's `authSecret`, `authIssuer` and `authAudience`, which must match the API's AUTH_* settings.

exec: // Mints HS256 access tokens from the environment, the same way the API's
// development tool does, so no external identity provider is needed.
// accessToken has every scope; readOnlyToken only devices:read.
// Every response carries a request id; errors use RFC 9457 problem details.
